name: Law of Prägnanz (Law of Simplicity / Good Figure)
axiom: Of the readings a shape allows, perception takes the simplest and most regular.
trigger: A layout can be parsed two ways, and the harder reading is the one users settle on.

checklist.text: Align cards and panels to one grid so their edges resolve into a few straight lines.
Strip icon detail until the silhouette reads at a glance; keep one recognisable outline.
Replace diagonal cuts and stepped dividers with rectangles on the same axes.
Show a layout to someone for two seconds and ask what the page is made of.

antiPattern.violation: Cards are skewed and cut on diagonals with stepped dividers, so every block needs tracing.
antiPattern.remediation: Cards are rectangles on one grid, with edges that line up and a readable silhouette.

parametricParams.caption: ONE OF THESE IS WHAT YOU SEE

academicOrigin.title: Untersuchungen zur Lehre von der Gestalt II
